cases.purpose: Child output and shell status after SIGTERM
cases.oracle: Linux wait status and shell convention: termination by signal N yields 128+N; bytes written before termination remain visible.
cases.comparison: Exact child stdout, stderr and shell-observed builtin status.
cases.script:
ionice -c 2 -n 4 /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import os,signal; os.write(1,b"child-out
"); os.write(2,b"child-err
"); os.kill(os.getpid(),signal.SIGTERM)'; printf 'status=%s
' "$?"
